whats_this_body: Nightcord is a self-hosted chat app — connect to a server your admin (or you) is running.
whats_this_point_servers: There is no central Nightcord service. Every server is run by someone (maybe you) on their own machine.
whats_this_point_accounts: Accounts are per server. Your username and password only work on the server you made them on.
whats_this_point_data: Your messages live on that server, not with us. This page only remembers the servers you've joined, on this device.
whats_this_point_start: Got an address? Paste it under New server. Running your own? Try localhost:8765.
no_saved_servers: You haven't saved any servers yet.
localhost_title: Fill in a server running on this computer
auto_reconnect_label: Reconnect to my last server on startup
setup_code_intro_before: This server has no owner yet. The server printed a one-time
setup_code_intro_after: in its console when it started.
owner_account_intro: Create the server-owner account. It manages accounts, server settings and can read any guild.
account_creation_request: People who ask — I approve each one
setup_change_later_note: You can change all of this later in User settings → Server.
legal_intro: Before you join, read this server's rules. You'll be asked to accept them when you create an account.
preview_hint: No server needed: a pretend one runs in this tab, and nothing you do leaves it.
